title: No Limit Arena
description: Your board grows every time you win, and Powerup cards land right on the grid.
fullDescription:
The board itself levels up.

You start on a 2x2 grid. Reach its target tile and the arena grows - 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 - and every size you unlock stays unlocked. There is no final board and no winning tile. The grid keeps growing for as long as you keep merging.

THE ARENA GROWS WITH YOU
Every grid has a target. Hit it and the board expands, permanently. A bigger arena means more room, longer chains and bigger numbers - and a target that has moved out of reach again. Your unlocked size is waiting the next time you open the game.

CARDS LAND ON THE BOARD
Powerup cards drop onto the grid while you play. A card takes up a cell and blocks merges until you use it, so where one lands is part of the puzzle. Tap it to fire it:

- Bomb - destroys the selected tile
- Magnet - pulls every tile of the same value into the one you choose
- Joker - your next move spawns a wildcard that merges with anything
- Sort - re-orders the whole board when it jams up
- Multiply - multiplies the selected tile x2, or x4 if you are lucky

Cards you have not been dealt can be stocked with keys and played from the bar.

NO CEILING
8,192. 65,536. 1,048,576. Tiles keep doubling as long as you keep playing, and the board keeps growing to hold them.

ENDLESS MODE
Want one grid and a clean run? Endless plays out on a single fixed board, with the same powerup cards in the deck and its own high score to beat.

KEEP WHAT YOU EARN
- Silver, gold and star chests, each on its own timer
- A prize wheel for keys and diamonds
- A global leaderboard, and 30 achievements to chase
- Cloud save, so a new device picks up exactly where you left off

EASY TO START, HARD TO PUT DOWN
Swipe to move. Matching tiles merge and double. One rule, one thumb, no timer - play a round while the kettle boils or chase a grid unlock all evening.

Swipe. Merge. Watch the arena get bigger.

No Limit Arena is free to play, contains ads, and offers optional in-app purchases.

title: Bird Hunter
description: Bird Hunter isn't your average mobile game. The sky above you is alive — birds are closing in, eggs are dropping fast, and the chaos keeps building with every second you wait. You have a cannon. You have one job. Blast as many eggs as you can before they hit the ground and damage your cannon. Simple to understand, brutally hard to master — and impossible to put down.
fullDescription:
Most games ask you to survive. Bird Hunter dares you to stay in control.

The arena is yours — until the birds show up. They come in waves, they come in numbers, and they come with one goal: overwhelm you. As they swoop across the sky, they drop eggs that fall straight toward the ground. Your job is to shoot them down before they break through your defense. Miss too many and the pressure builds. Every egg that slips through damages your cannon — and if it takes too many hits, it won't survive.

What makes it electric is what happens when you hit. Bigger eggs don't just disappear — they crack open and split into smaller ones, scattering across the screen and multiplying the chaos in an instant. One well-placed shot can set off a chain reaction that clears the board. A badly-timed one can bury you under a storm of shells you never saw coming.

Bird Hunter is built around that tension — the thrill of keeping everything under control while the screen fills up and the pressure climbs. Chain your shots into combos, manage what's falling, choose the right cannon for the moment, and push through 30 chapters and 20 levels each — 600 levels total — that keep getting sharper, faster, and more satisfying the deeper you go.

Every few levels, you earn a spin. Every spin brings something new — a power-up, a weapon, a boost that shifts how you play. That's Bird Hunter. Fast. Focused. Relentless.

## Core Mechanics

**The Egg System** — Eggs come in four sizes — small, medium, large, and massive. When you shoot a large egg, it doesn't vanish. It breaks into two medium eggs. Shoot those and you get four small ones. Shoot a massive egg and the whole thing cascades — one well-placed bullet can eventually turn into eight falling targets. A miss on a big egg doesn't just mean you wasted a shot — it means that egg is getting closer to the ground and it's about to multiply.

**Pressure System** — Every egg carries a weight value — bigger eggs carry more. When the total weight of everything falling at once crosses the level's limit, birds temporarily stop releasing new eggs, giving you a moment to breathe. But it's a short window. The pressure system isn't a safety net — it's the game telling you you're already behind.

**Scoring and Combos** — Chaining shots together — hitting egg after egg without missing — builds a combo multiplier that bumps your score significantly and drops coin bonuses along the way. Accuracy isn't just satisfying, it's mechanically rewarded. Each level has a target score you need to hit within a specific time window.

**How Difficulty Grows** — Bird Hunter doesn't just get harder in one direction. Difficulty climbs two ways at the same time. The further you progress across all 30 chapters, the challenge steadily increases. Within each chapter's 20 levels, difficulty builds progressively, with spikes at key levels. The game also includes an adaptive relief system that temporarily adjusts spawn rates after sustained struggle.

## Cannons

**Single Cannon** — Fires a single projectile per attack cycle. The baseline weapon for performance balancing across other cannon types.

**Rapid Cannon** — Fires 1 bullet per attack cycle with higher firing speed. Generates consistent sustained damage output.

**Spread Cannon** — Fires wide, covering ground that a focused shot never could — perfect for moments when the screen is filling faster than you can track.

**Explosive Cannon** — Deals area damage on impact and can clear clusters that would take a focused shot twice as long to handle.

**Critical Cannon** — Hits harder on key strikes, rewarding accuracy with damage spikes that cut through tougher egg tiers.

**Dual Cannon** — Fires two shots at once — chaotic in the best possible way, and genuinely powerful in the right hands.

**Tri Cannon** — Fires three shots at once — maximum firepower for players who know how to use it.

## Upgrade System

Every cannon in Bird Hunter has ten upgrade levels — and the difference between a level one cannon and a fully upgraded one is not subtle. Upgrades are built around two resources: coins and materials. Coins you earn naturally as you play — by destroying eggs, chaining combos, and clearing levels. Materials come through gameplay milestones and spin rewards. There is no single cannon that outperforms everything else at every upgrade level. You are building a collection of tools and learning when to use each one.
tagline: Eggs are falling fast. Protect your cannon or it's game over.

title: Smashy Qube
description: Slide. Smash. Win. A satisfying cube puzzle with one simple rule.
fullDescription:
Smashy Qube is a satisfying slide puzzle game that's easy to pick
up but hard to put down.

Swipe your jelly cube across the grid and smash every Red target to
clear the level. Sounds simple — until walls, portals, moving
platforms, spike traps, and Crack floors get in your way.

FEATURES
- handcrafted levels
- Unique obstacles — portals, spikes, rotating bars, moving blocks
- Satisfying jelly soft-body physics on every move
- 3-star rating system — can you perfect every level?
- Global leaderboard — compete with players worldwide
- Clean, minimal design with smooth animations

HOW TO PLAY
Swipe in any direction to slide your cube. It moves until it hits
a wall or obstacle. Smash all the targets to win. Use your moves
wisely — fewer moves means more stars.

Can you master all levels?

title: Endless Merge 2048
description: Shoot & merge cubes to 2048 and beyond in this addictive 3D puzzle game!
fullDescription:
Endless Merge 2048 is a satisfying 3D merge puzzle where you shoot numbered cubes onto a physics board and watch them combine — 2, 4, 8, 16… all the way to 2048 and beyond!

Aim, shoot, and stack matching cubes to merge them into bigger numbers. Chain combos for huge points, keep the board under control, and push for your highest score in a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down.

🎯 SIMPLE, ADDICTIVE GAMEPLAY
Just tap and aim to launch your cube. Land it next to matching numbers to merge — the more you chain, the higher your score climbs.

♾️ ENDLESS MODE
There's no finish line — only your best run. Every game is a fresh chance to beat your high score.

🏆 GLOBAL LEADERBOARD
Compete with players around the world. Climb the rankings and prove you're the ultimate merge master.

💣 POWER-UPS
Stuck in a tight spot? Use the Bomb to clear cubes and the Magnet to pull matches together when the board heats up.

🧊 SATISFYING PHYSICS
Real cube physics make every merge feel chunky and rewarding — tumble, stack, and combine in glorious 3D.

✨ FEATURES
• Addictive 2048-style merge mechanics
• Endless gameplay with high-score chasing
• Worldwide leaderboard
• Bomb & Magnet power-ups
• Smooth, colorful 3D visuals
• Free to play

Download Endless Merge 2048 now, start shooting cubes, and see how far you can climb. Can you reach 2048?

title: Last Turn

How far can you go?

Last Turn is a fast-paced arcade driving game that puts your reflexes to the test. Drift through sharp corners, avoid obstacles, collect coins, and survive for as long as you can using simple one-touch controls.

Easy to learn. Challenging to master. Impossible to put down!

🎮 EASY ONE-TOUCH CONTROLS

Hold to turn. Release to drive straight.

Simple controls let anyone play, while mastering every turn requires precision and perfect timing.

♾️ TWO GAME MODES

ENDLESS MODE

• Beat your highest score.
• Survive increasing speed and difficulty.

LEVEL MODE
• Complete handcrafted levels.
• Reach the finish line.
• Master unique track layouts.

🚗 UNLOCK AWESOME CARS

Collect coins during every run and unlock a variety of stylish cars, each featuring its own unique look and colorful drift trail.

🎁 DAILY REWARDS

Spin the daily reward wheel every day to earn free coins and unlock new cars even faster.

🏆 COMPETE FOR THE TOP

Challenge yourself, beat your friends, and climb the leaderboard to prove you're the ultimate driver.

✨ FEATURES

• Fast-paced arcade gameplay
• Simple one-touch controls
• Endless and Level game modes
• Unlock multiple unique cars
• Daily rewards
• Smooth drifting mechanics
• Colorful visuals and satisfying effects
• Endless replayability
• Free to play

Every turn matters. Every second counts.

Think you've got what it takes?

Download Last Turn and start drifting today!

title: Sweet Tumble
description: Sort tumbling candies into matching color gates! Tap, match & beat your score.
fullDescription:
Sweet Tumble is the deliciously simple color-sorting game that's easy to pick up and impossible to put down!

- Candies come tumbling out of the dispenser one by one — your job is to send each one through its matching color gate. Just tap to flip the gate, line up the colors, and keep the sweets flowing. Miss a match and you'll lose a life… so stay sharp!

It starts off gentle and relaxing, but don't get too comfortable. The candies fall faster and faster, new colors keep joining the mix, and before you know it you're making split-second decisions to keep your streak alive. One more candy. One more point. One more try!

🍬 HOW TO PLAY
• Watch the next candy drop from the dispenser
• Tap to flip the gate to the matching color
• Sort it correctly to score — send it to the wrong gate and you lose a life
• Survive as long as you can and beat your high score!

✨ FEATURES
• One-tap controls — anyone can play in seconds
• Endless gameplay — chase your personal best again and again
• Ramping difficulty — speed climbs and new colors appear the longer you last
• Satisfying & relaxing — smooth candy physics and soothing sounds
• Unlock fun skins — customize your candies and backgrounds in the shop
• Get a second chance — earn an extra life to keep your run going
• Play offline — no internet required, perfect for anywhere
• Free to play — jump in and start sorting!

Whether you've got five seconds or fifty minutes, Sweet Tumble is the perfect bite-sized brain-teaser. Test your reflexes, train your focus, and find out how long you can keep the candy flowing.

Can you sort them all? Download Sweet Tumble now and start the sweet chaos! 🍭
tagline: Sort the chaos, one tumble at a time.

title: Twisty Snake
description: Twist through rings, grow your snake & blast into Fire Mode in this tube run!
fullDescription:
Twist. Dodge. Grow. Go fire!

Twisty Snake is the addictive one-finger runner that turns a simple idea into pure "just one more run" fun. Guide your snake down
an endless spinning tube, twist to slip through the gap in every obstacle ring, and watch your snake grow longer with every
flawless move. Sounds easy? The rings come faster, the gaps get tighter, and the only way forward is to stay perfect.

HOW TO PLAY
• Hold and twist to rotate your snake and line up with each ring's gap.
• Slide through cleanly — no touching! — to score a Perfect.
• Every Perfect grows your snake and builds your combo.
• Clip a ring and your combo resets, so keep your nerve.

CHASE FIRE MODE
String together perfect passes to fill the meter (0/4 → 4/4). Hit the top and your snake erupts into FIRE MODE — a blazing fire
head that smashes straight through obstacles in a shower of effects. It's the most satisfying moment in the game, and it's all
about your skill.

ENDLESS, EVER-HARDER LEVELS
There's no finish line. Levels are generated on the fly and ramp up forever — longer tubes, trickier ring angles and meaner
obstacle patterns the deeper you go. Every five levels you "Level Up" and start with a bigger snake. How far can you push it?

COLLECT & CUSTOMIZE
• Grab sparkling diamonds mid-run to cash in bonus coins.
• Unlock a collection of snake skins and swap your look.
• Change the whole vibe with vortex tube skins, trails and color themes.
• Spend your coins your way and make every run feel fresh.

BEAT YOUR BEST
Every run logs your score and pushes you toward a new personal record. Come back daily to keep your streak alive — and to find out
if today is the day you finally hit a new high.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Pick-up-and-play one-finger controls — easy to learn, tough to master.
• Oddly satisfying twist-and-grow gameplay with juicy effects and haptics.
• Quick runs that fit any spare minute.
• Plays offline, anywhere.
• Free to play.

Sign in with Google Play Games to keep your progress safe across sessions.

Can you stay perfect, chase the combo and ride the fire? Download Twisty Snake now and find out how long your snake — and your
nerve — can really get!

title: Park Escape
description: Untangle the traffic! Tap cars to escape the jam before time runs out.
fullDescription:
Gridlock never felt this good to solve.

Park Escape is the tap-to-play traffic puzzle where every car is stuck — and only you can set them free. Tap a car, watch
it drive along its path to the exit, and clear the whole jam before the timer hits zero. Easy to start, deliciously
tricky to master.

🚗 ONE-THUMB PLAY
Just tap. Each car knows its route — your job is the order. Simple enough for a quick break, deep enough to keep you
thinking.

⏱️ BEAT THE CLOCK
Every level is a race. Read the jam, plan your moves, and escape before time runs out. Nail it with seconds to spare for
that perfect clear.

🧩 HUNDREDS OF PUZZLES
From gentle warm-ups to brain-bending gridlocks packed with gates, poles, and switches. The difficulty ramps just right —
you'll always feel that "one more level" pull.

🚦 OBSTACLES THAT BITE
Flip gates, trigger colored poles, hit buttons in the right order. Later levels turn the parking lot into a proper puzzle
box.

🏆 CLIMB, COLLECT, COMPETE
Earn coins, unlock a garage of cars, and chase the leaderboard. Show off your best and prove you're the sharpest driver
on the road.

✨ MADE FOR MOBILE
Snappy controls, satisfying feedback, quick sessions. Play offline, anywhere.

Think you can clear the jam? Tap in and escape the gridlock.

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases and ads.
